en: Yesterday's riddle: seventeen sheep, and all but nine run away. How many are left?
All but nine means: every sheep ran away, except nine.
So nine sheep stay on the farm. The answer is nine!
Person one holds up a calendar, and asks a question.
Some months have thirty-one days. Some have thirty. How many months have twenty-eight days?
Person two says: only one! Person three says: no way!
So, how many months have twenty-eight days?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
